reviews.feedback: 1) internal/api/customers_import.go:145 uses store.FindCustomerByEmail(orgID, ...), but internal/store/customers.go:120-128 ignores orgID, so an email held by another organization's customer is wrongly reported as email_taken; the spec says only the same organization's customers block an email. Fix the lookup to return only customers with s.customers[id].OrgID == orgID (this also fixes GET /v1/customers?email=). 2) customersByEmail (customers.go:58, 120-128, and CreateCustomers' check) maps each email to one customer across all organizations, so a same-organization duplicate can be missed when another organization shares the email; make the lookup per organization. 3) Add an import test where another organization already has the email and the import succeeds, plus a store test with two organizations sharing an email.
